annotations.title: Check recorded openings for a permit or campground

description: Shows what PermitSnag has recorded for one US backcountry permit or one campground over a range of up to 62 days. Answers come from PermitSnag's own stored checks of the booking site, not a live look, and nothing is booked. Each date has one state: observed_opening (an opening seen recently, with when it was last seen), observed_no_match (a recent check that saw no opening, with its time), stale (the newest check is older than staleAfterHours, with its time), unknown (no usable check of that date), unreleased (not on sale yet, by the agency's release rule or the booking site), off_season (outside the agency's published season), closed (closed by the agency) or unsupported (PermitSnag does not check this place). Neither stale nor unknown means sold out. Permit dates are shown as they stood 15 minutes ago. For a permit split into zones or entry points, our checks may cover only some of them, so a date with no opening seen comes back as unknown, never as observed_no_match.

campground.description: The campground id from search_campgrounds. Give this or permit, not both.

endDate.description: Last date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to startDate. The range covers at most 62 days, counting both ends.

permit.description: The permit id or slug from search_permits. Give this or campground, not both.

startDate.description: First date, YYYY-MM-DD, read as the place's own local calendar day (for a campground, the night you arrive).

name: check_availability

outputSchema.description: PermitSnag's recorded checks of one permit or campground on the asked dates; an observed or stale date carries the time and age of its check. Not a live look at the booking site. Or found: false, or past: true.

available.description: True only when PermitSnag can send an alert for this place right now.

pageUrl.description: The PermitSnag page where an alert is set up, or where to read what to do instead.

reason.description: Why an alert is or is not on offer.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the place's own local calendar day.

lastSeenState.description: For a stale date: what that old check saw.

observedAt.description: The time of the check behind an observed or stale state (for an opening, when it was last seen), ISO 8601. For a permit, never later than publicDelayMinutes ago.

openSites.description: Campgrounds at site level only: sites seen open.

releasesOn.description: For an unreleased date: the sourced day it goes on sale, when known.

state.description: What PermitSnag recorded for this date. Neither stale nor unknown means sold out.

found.description: Present, and false, only when nothing matched.

partialScope.description: Permits only: true when our checks may cover only some zones or entry points, so no date is called "no opening".

past.description: Present only when every asked date has passed.

publicDelayMinutes.description: Permits only: dates are described as they stood this many minutes ago.

scanRoute.description: How PermitSnag reaches this permit for cancellation openings: direct, through a zone or starting area, through its entry points, or none.

staleAfterHours.description: Hours. A check older than this is never reported as observed; it is reported as stale (or as unknown, when partialScope hides a check that saw no opening).

title: Check recorded openings for a permit or campground
